_note: Chợ (building market): the only place goods are traded. Every good has a value in shells (resources.json barter: how many of it one shell is worth). Selling gives shells at that value times `rate`; swapping one good for another gives the value of what is given less `fee`. Each day the market takes only so much of each good at the fair price: `quotaMin` to `quotaMax` shells' worth, drawn anew every day (the level of the market sets the range); past that, each further shell costs `overSlip` more than the one before. The village keeps back `keepShare` of the store of a good (and three days of meals of food) unless the player says otherwise. `medieval`: goods that cannot be traded before the medieval age. `free`: swaps open from the first level of the market; the rest are opened by research (techs `trade:<give>><get>`).
